== Walkthrough ==

''[[Gunlok Jure]] is located at 1315, 158, 39 in the Paladin guild. You must have Indifferent faction to complete this quest.''

You say, 'Hail, Gunlok Jure'

: Gunlok Jure says, 'Hail, ______! Bow before the greatness of the Clerics of Underfoot! It is good to be a paladin in such an order as ours - to fight the good fight and defend Kaladim from the evil and undead. If you be a paladin, then I pray you find the [courage to battle the undead].'

You say, 'I have the courage to battle the undead'

: Gunlok Jure says, 'Yes!! To battle the undead is our greatest call. There has been a rise in the number of dwarven skeletons seen in the Butcherblocks. If you are a true member of this order, I shall reward you for the return of four bone chips. We shall defend our land from evil!'

'''Hand [[Gunlok Jure]] 4 [[Bone Chips]], unstacked.'''

: Gunlok Jure says, 'I called for the remains of four skeletons.'

: Gunlok Jure says, 'I called for the remains of four skeletons.'

: Gunlok Jure says, 'I called for the remains of four skeletons.'

: Gunlok Jure says, 'You have done well. We thank you for your deed with this humble reward. The power behind the raising of our dead shall soon be found. You will earn more respect with more bone chips. I only wish you could assist in the return of the [remains of Cromil].'

<div class="facblock">
* Your faction standing with [[Clerics of Underfoot]] got better. 
* Your faction standing with [[Kazon Stormhammer]] got better. 
* Your faction standing with [[Miners Guild 249]] got better. 
</div>

{{YouGainExperience}}

You receive 15 silver, 6 copper pieces.

== Notes ==

''Note: You must have at least indifferent faction to do this quest.''

''Note: Maybe not. Human cleric following Innoruuk was able to complete at Apprehensive''

''Note: This quest is heavily nerfed on Green/Teal. As a WE Druid, I turned in 3 stacks of bone chips at level 3 to give ~4% per turn in. Don't waste your time.''

Doing this quest about 100 times will take your faction from scowling to warmly.

As a Human Wizard on Green (5/2/2020) I went from 4-6 with 4 stacks. First turn in dinged 5 and last turn in dinged 6, also went from apprehensive to amiable

As an Erudite Cleric (Prexus) on blue (26 Mar 2023), went from 1-13 using 2016 bonechips. This includes the exp for turning in the note to guild after character creation.

''Note: While this quest can help low-level characters level up quickly, those characters will not gain the skill level increases (melee, spell casting etc.) they might have gotten during normal levelling.''

=== Notes ===

Based on the Ranger and Bard data, the quest turn-in is between 3165 to 3184 XP, unless that amount is more than 1/8 of a level or it completes the level.
The XP reward also cannot be more than 3184 XP, otherwise 40 turn-ins would have completed level 6 on the Ranger and Bard.

As a fun thought experiment. It requires 64,689,900 to go from level 59 to 60. At 3,184 xp per turn in it would require 20,318 turn ins to level from this quest. At 4 chips required per turn-in that is 81,272 bone chips. This is 4,064 stacks of bone chips. At a normal market price of 10p per stack thats 40,064 plat worth of chips. If it takes you 5 seconds to click in each quest turn in, it would take 101,590 non-stop seconds of clicking in bone chips. This is over 28 hours of clicking. This does not include all of the time it would take to transport or purchase this many stacks of bonechips.
